gate_reasoning: 76.4% of claims score Low confidence, well above the 70% FAIL threshold. The dominant failure mode is the single-source override — most quantitative claims (price series, market volumes, quality parameters) are supported by exactly one source, even when that source is high-quality. The IEA Newcastle price series (VC-2.1–2.5) generates five Low claims from one primary source that could become High or Medium with any second corroborating source. The coal grade price table (VC-1.15–1.16, VC-2.6–2.7) has no primary source at all — Argus Coalindo ICI methodology is cited but not the actual Argus price data. The Japan METI FIT halt (PP1.1-6), which is the structural demand cliff driving all of PP1.1 RC5, has no primary METI source. The moisture efficiency figure (PP1.3-3) comes from a vendor blog and contaminates the entire cost calculation chain in PP1.3. There are also four ASSUMED tags that are each individually Low. The stage has strong structural narrative quality and several claims are genuinely well-sourced (DMO regulatory framework PP1.2-8, monsoon seasonality PP1.3-6, GGL certification cost PP1.1-5), but the overall citation density is too thin for a re-run pass.
